name: Workable
tagline: ATS REST API for jobs, candidates, and hiring workflows
description: Workable is a popular applicant tracking system (ATS) with a REST API for managing jobs, candidates, and hiring workflows. Developers can integrate with Workable to automate recruitment processes, sync candidate data, and manage job postings programmatically.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header, self-serve signup

use_cases: list open job postings from a Workable account
fetch candidate applications for a job
